meta.title: AgentBridge — Connector Verification Pipeline Workflow
meta.subtitle: 12-Stage Deterministic Verification & State Aggregation Machine
meta.description: Multi-stage verification workflow executing 12 independent checks across configuration, network reachability, credential authenticity, capabilities, tool clients, diagnostics, and historical usage evidence without provider branching.

states.label: Analysis Triggered
states.description: Triggered via explicit API (analyze/analyze_all) or on connector registration hook with correlated request_id.

states.label: Fetch Descriptor
states.description: Extracts standardized ConnectorAnalysisDescriptor from ConnectorRegistry containing declared vars, binaries, and transport hints.

states.label: Stage 1: Discovery
states.description: Executes EnvironmentProbe: host OS, architecture, Python version, working directory, and write permissions.

states.label: Stage 2: Configuration
states.description: Checks declared environment variables and config schema. PASS if all present, UNKNOWN if partial/missing declared vars.

states.label: Stage 5: Connection
states.description: Attempts non-destructive connection probe if enabled. Distinguishes network REACHABLE from unreachability.

states.label: Stage 6: Authentication
states.description: Validates credential acceptance. PASS=AUTHENTICATED, FAIL=auth rejected, UNKNOWN=untested or missing validation mechanism.

states.label: Stage 7: Capabilities
states.description: Discovers and inventories declared tools and resources without mutating external state.

states.label: Stages 8-9: CLI & Clients
states.description: Checks local binary availability (which/where.exe) and workstation tool integrations (Cursor, VS Code, AgentBridge).

states.label: Stages 10-11: Health & Latency
states.description: Executes diagnostic health check and measures end-to-end roundtrip latency in milliseconds.

states.label: Stage 12: Usage Evidence
states.description: Queries ActivityStore for tool_call_start records. Yields OBSERVED_IN_USE, NOT_OBSERVED, or UNKNOWN (if store absent).

states.label: Evidence Aggregation FSM
states.description: Deterministically aggregates check results into VerificationState: UNCONFIGURED, CONFIGURED, CONNECTED, AUTHENTICATED, CAPABILITY_DISCOVERED, VERIFIED, or FAILED.

states.label: Audit & Observability
states.description: Records analysis event in ActivityStore (sanitized), increments Metrics counters, and returns immutable AnalysisReport.
